name: Imscribing Magic

phase_0.boundary_condition: The totality of the inscribed medium acting as a hermetic vessel for the invoked essence.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state before the first mark is etched into the medium.

TANCH.justification: The integer boundary that prevents the magical field from dissipating.

AFWD.justification: The directed flow of will from the scribe into the medium.

AREV.justification: The feedback loop where the medium informs the scribe of the manifestation.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of glyphs to form a coherent magical instruction.

IMSCRIB.justification: The mark that recognizes its own existence as the source of the magic.

FSPLIT.justification: The divergence of intent into active manifestation and latent structural support.

FFUSE.justification: The convergence of active and latent paths back into the singular magical effect.

EVALT.justification: The positive confirmation that the inscription has successfully anchored the essence.

EVALF.justification: The negative state where the inscription fails to hold the required winding number.

ENGAGR.justification: The state where the inscription is both active and latent simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible fixation of the magical record into the physical substrate.

phase_3.void_description: The blank medium prior to any contact with the scribe.
phase_3.true_description: The state of successful magical anchoring where the winding number is non-zero.
phase_3.false_description: The state of structural collapse where the inscription fails to hold.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the inscription during the act of writing where potential and actual are indistinguishable.

steps.domain_action: Divergence of intent into active and latent paths.
Projection of intent along the active path.
Recirculation of essence along the latent path.
Negative evaluation of the latent path.
Chaining the intent to the medium.
Sealing the system within the winding number boundary.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The scribe's consciousness acting as the primary logic gate.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Resonance between the medium and the scribe's intent.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The physical structure of the medium itself.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The sequence of strokes defined by the imscriptive grammar.
phase_5.alfs_store: The canonical set of glyphs defined in the CLINK L8 reference.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The scribe's life force or focused attention.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is a closed loop where the energy of the scribe is perfectly conserved within the structural integrity of the inscription.
